name: Host Filesystem Memory Adapter
description: SAFOR Memory adapter for a host-provided persistent filesystem or mounted volume.

model.eligibilityRule: The host must explicitly expose a persistent path or mounted storage and SAFOR must prove it can reopen the same stable location after session boundaries. Ephemeral scratch space is ineligible.
model.sharedTeamEligibility: Only when the host additionally proves memory.shared_access and either memory.compare_and_swap or memory.lock.
model.revisionStrategy: Use a durable SAFOR revision metadata record and atomic replacement/locking semantics exposed by the host.
model.forbiddenAssumption: A local path is not durable merely because a file write succeeded once.
